cpu.title: CPU benchmark

cpu.mode.sustained.desc: Repeats the scene for at least 10 minutes on all threads: shows whether the CPU slows down as it heats up.

soon.gpu.title: GPU benchmark
soon.gpu.desc: A 3D game scene in Direct3D 11 scored by average FPS and 1% low, plus a GPU-Z-style page (real VRAM, clocks, PCIe, Resizable BAR).
soon.memory.title: Memory benchmark
soon.memory.desc: Latency (pointer chase), read and copy bandwidth, and game map load time.
soon.disk.title: Disk benchmark
soon.disk.desc: Sequential 1 MB, 4K QD1 and 4K QD32 like CrystalDiskMark, plus SSD/HDD SMART health.
soon.stressCpu.title: CPU stress test
soon.stressCpu.desc: Full load on every thread with a temperature limit and automatic stop.
soon.stressGpu.title: GPU stress test
soon.stressGpu.desc: A FurMark-style "furry" torus in Direct3D 11, with a temperature limit.
soon.stressRam.title: RAM test
soon.stressRam.desc: Writes and verifies patterns across most free memory, counting errors.
soon.games.title: Game library
soon.games.desc: Finds games from Steam, Epic, GOG, Ubisoft, EA, Battle.net and Xbox, with covers, per-game performance profiles and play time.
soon.drivers.title: Driver updater
soon.drivers.desc: Lists installed drivers, looks for updates on Windows Update and the NVIDIA, AMD and Intel sites, and creates a restore point before installing.
soon.extras.title: Extras
soon.extras.desc: In-game FPS overlay, bottleneck detector and online result comparison.
gpuz.notInDb: Card not in the spec database: showing only what the driver reports.
gpu.title: GPU benchmark
gpu.subtitle: A Direct3D 11 game scene: a valley with 40,000 trees, real-time shadows, water and HDR. Same scene and camera on every PC.
gpu.window: The scene opens in its own window (Esc cancels). Sensor polling pauses during the test so it doesn't disturb the measurement; the first 3 seconds are warm-up and don't count.
gpu.ranking.empty: Results for this resolution and duration show up here. To compare with other PCs, import JSON reports on the Reports page.
stress.title: GPU stress test
stress.subtitle: A FurMark-style furry torus: maximum shader, overdraw and blending load to test temperatures, stability and the power supply.
stress.warning: This test pushes the graphics card to its power and temperature limits. Keep an eye on the readings and keep the automatic limit on.
stress.noSensor: There's no GPU temperature reading, so the automatic cutoff won't work. Continue anyway?
stress.status.running: Running. Esc in the test window also stops it.
stress.summary: {0} frames · average {1} FPS · max temperature {2} · duration {3}
cli.gpu.notWindows: GPU tests only work on Windows.
cli.usage:
Supernova Bench — command line

Usage:
  supernova-cli bench cpu [--mode multi|single|sustained] [--quick] [--threads N] [--minutes M] [--json] [--save] [--bmp file.bmp]
  supernova-cli bench gpu [--res 1080p|1440p|4k] [--seconds N] [--warp] [--headless]
  supernova-cli gpu info
  supernova-cli info

Options:
  --quick     quick preset (480×270, 64 samples/pixel)
  --minutes   sustained mode duration (default 10)
  --json      print the result as JSON
  --save      store the result in the app history
  --warp      software GPU (WARP) with a reduced scene, for testing
  --lang      pt-BR or en
